name: Charades Game
author: mixaliskappas

sections.description:
Bring the classic Charades (Pantomime) game to your WordPress website. Whether you’re at a party, in a classroom, or just bored at home — this plugin transforms your browser into an interactive and engaging team-based word guessing game!

🎭 Features:

  • Create custom categories with optional icons (recommended size: 64×64 px)
  • Add your own words or phrases per category
  • Include an optional comment or hint for each word (e.g., author, year, clue)
  • Two-team rotation system for turn-based gameplay
  • Built-in timer and automatic scoring system
  • Tie-breaker logic using average team response times
  • Wake Lock enabled to prevent screen sleep during play
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly – play on any device!
  • No logins, no third-party accounts required

🧩 Perfect for:
– Family gatherings & parties
– Classroom activities & educational games
– Remote team-building sessions
– Ice-breakers and social events

How It Works

  1. The admin creates categories (e.g., “Books”, “Movies”, “Animals”) and uploads a 64x64px icon.
  2. Each category contains words/phrases and optionally a short comment (e.g., “The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo” – Author: Larsson Stieg).
  3. Players split into two teams and choose team names.
  4. A random word or phrase is shown to one team while the others guess.
  5. Each team has a set time (default: 90 seconds) to act out and guess the word.
  6. Teams alternate turns; correct guesses earn points.
  7. The team with the most points (or the fastest response time in a tie) wins!

Shortcode

To add the game to any page or post, use:
[charades_game]

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/charades-game directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Charades Game in the WordPress dashboard to start adding your custom content.
  4. Create a page or post and use the shortcode below to embed the game interface.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin mobile friendly?

Absolutely. The game is fully responsive and works smoothly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.

Can I use my own words and categories?

Yes! You can fully customize the game content to suit your audience or event.

Can more than two teams play?

Currently, the game is designed for two alternating teams. Future updates may include more options.

Are repeated words avoided?

Yes. Words are automatically tracked and excluded from immediate repetition.

Will the screen stay awake during gameplay?

Yes. The plugin uses the Wake Lock API to prevent sleep mode. Note: Some mobile browsers (e.g., iOS Safari) may have limited support.

Do I need an internet connection to play?

Only to load the game page. All gameplay runs entirely in-browser.

Can I support development?

Sure! Crypto donations are welcome – see below for wallet addresses.
